name: Zhel Tyrres
source:
Zhel is a fanboy of the newly appointed heroes. His enthusiasm sometimes gets the best of him.

He is infamous for failing to craft gems and easily gets persuaded to give his services for free.

Specialty: Handling Magic Gems

[From [url=http://unbrokenhours.com/ruin/characters/zhel/]official site[/url]]
